searchText: I guess quite a lot test-eth was lost for this incident? Or is it that nobody is really punished for chain not being finalized? Everyone on the wrong fork was inactivity leaking, so they did loose some eth (the same amount they would have earned). No one signed anything that contradicts themselves, so no one was slashed. You can see the amount of lost eth here: https://beaconchain.kintsugi.themerge.dev/ the staked eth amount went down by 100k eth? I guess some validators got kicked out? Nope, that was the amount of eth that was inactivity leaked - Explanation of why it's so high is here: https://www.reddit.com/r/ethstaker/comments/g04rmk/penalties_for_inactive_nodes/fn897uw/ ah right. Yeah, I have read that seems like around 5% of all staked eth was lost. That's a lot whats this blib? Yeah, we would need to lose enough stake for the chain to finalize again (punish the offline nodes) within a reasonable timeframe We had some periods where certain combination of clients came back online, so that reduction in leaking would probably be that blip hmm, so some clients were behaving correctly at times? I think monday evening <@!199561711278227457> deployed some fixes which temporarily resurrected the teku nodes, before they encountered the geth sync bugs <@!360491619402776577> You can see the average lh-geth node disk usage reduce once finality occurs. Unsure why yours hasn't pruned. Weird Both of my LH nodes have not pruned (afaict) 27G ./testnet-lh1/beacon 27G ./testnet-lh1/beacon 27G ./testnet-lh1 27G ./testnet-lh1 26G ./testnet-lh1/beacon/chain_db 26G ./testnet-lh1/beacon/chain_db 23G ./testnet-lh2/beacon 23G ./testnet-lh2/beacon 23G ./testnet-lh2 23G ./testnet-lh2 22G ./testnet-lh2/beacon/chain_db 22G ./testnet-lh2/beacon/chain_db Wait, my second node did prune itself now huh maybe an operation that happens every 24 hours or something? Lighthouse devs: Is the Lighthouse VC calling the `/eth/v1/validator/prepare_beacon_proposer` endpoint and if so does the VC only do that once at start up or does it periodically "refresh" it? How often does it refresh? <@!612776905380200459> is using a lighthouse VC with a Teku beacon and it's not proposing blocks - the logs look like teku doesn't have a block proposer registered for the slot it's trying to create a block for so we can't create a payload.
